other_conditions: Must be a native of Chhattisgarh state.
Must have passed at least 8th class.
Only one applicant per family is allowed.
Applicant must not be a defaulter of any nationalized bank, financial institution, or cooperative bank.
Family annual income must not exceed Rs. 3,00,000.
Definition of family includes spouse and children; if unmarried, includes parents and unmarried siblings.
Applicants who have previously received a grant under PMRYO, PMROSRIKA or any other government scheme are ineligible.
5‑year relaxation in maximum age limit for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PWD/Naxalite affected family members/Retired soldiers.
benefits_summary: Provides subsidized loans, guarantee fee assistance, interest subsidy, and margin‑money grants to support youth entrepreneurship.
